query: SELECT p.intent_id AS "intent_id!: String", p.state_epoch AS "state_epoch!: i64", p.state_position AS "state_position!: i64" FROM json_each(?) k CROSS JOIN board_intent_progress p ON p.project_id = ? AND p.intent_id = CAST(json_extract(k.value, '$[0]') AS TEXT) AND p.state_epoch = CAST(json_extract(k.value, '$[1].epoch') AS INTEGER) AND p.state_position = CAST(json_extract(k.value, '$[1].position') AS INTEGER) ORDER BY p.intent_id, p.state_epoch, p.state_position
